---
applyTo: docs/source/**/*.md,docs/source/*.md
---

Every documentation page under `docs/source/` starts with a `*By Name [@handle](https://github.com/handle)*` byline crediting its author(s).

- When adding a new page, or crediting an author for the first time in an existing page's byline, check `docs/source/index.md` under `## Maintainer(s)`.
- If that person isn't already listed under `Contributors:` or `Previously involved:`, add them to `Contributors:` using the same `- *Name [@handle](https://github.com/handle)*` format.
- Do not move a name between `Contributors:` and `Previously involved:`, or remove one, unless explicitly asked — that distinction reflects the maintainer's judgment about who is currently active, not something inferable from page bylines alone.
